items.title: Why Atkore, Belden And Flex Stock Are Gaining Attention In AI Data Centers
items.summary: AI data centers keep soaking up power and hardware spending while the Fed leans into higher-for-longer rates, and that mix is quietly reshaping which U.S. infrastructure stocks investors watch first. Big tech capex keeps flowing even as discount rates climb. This article examines three U.S. AI data center power and infrastructure stocks affected by that rate environment and spending cycle, and outlines why each may warrant closer attention now. items.title: Where Does Flex (FLEX) Value Sit After Its AI Power Deal?
items.summary: Flex Ltd. has been on a powerful multi year run, and with the stock now near recent highs, the real question for investors is whether today's valuation is still grounded in the cash the business can generate. Flex has delivered a very large 5 year share price gain of about 7x, which puts a lot of weight on whether its future cash flows can continue to support that kind of market value.
